title: Town rules
intro: Life Framework | Everon 1989 (Alpha). You are a person with a life here, not a soldier. These rules hold for everyone in town.
rules: No random violence: hurt someone only for a reason your character has.
Fear for your life: with a gun on you, comply, then report it.
New life: after a death, forget what led to it. Do not hunt the killer.
Keep disputes out of the streets. No stalking, no harassing.
No combat logging: play out an arrest, a robbery or a fight.
next: Take a complaint to staff after the scene, not during it. This is an alpha: the world can be wiped, with 24 hours' notice.
